description: Authoritative inventory of repository automation, verification, and workflow scripts in hummbl-io/oss.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only filesystem scan across package pyproject.toml and license headers; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on clean license compliance; exit 1 on missing license file or mismatched identifier.
scripts.integration_notes: Enforces Apache-2.0 / MIT license consistency across all monorepo packages prior to CI build matrix.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only filesystem inspection of locked dependency hashes in pyproject.toml; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on locked inputs; exit 1 on unpinned build dependencies or version drift.
scripts.integration_notes: Prerequisite gate in PyPI publish workflow guaranteeing hermetic, reproducible build environments.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only static verification of governance rules and contract adherence; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on successful verification; exit 1 on broken contracts or missing evidence.
scripts.integration_notes: Prototype verification engine slated for packaging into hummbl-governance CLI assessment toolset.

scripts.system_boundary: Local schema verification of AI position papers and policy claims; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on valid schema and assertions; exit 1 on assertion failure or malformed metadata.
scripts.integration_notes: Verifies structured policy assertions in docs/positions/ prior to public release.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only regular expression scan for private paths, internal hostnames, and credentials; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on clean scan; exit 1 on pattern violations or forbidden boundary leaks.
scripts.integration_notes: Primary gate preventing private architecture artifacts and internal secrets from landing in open source.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only inspection of repository automation scripts and scripts-inventory.json; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on complete inventory parity; exit 1 on uncataloged scripts, missing files, or schema discrepancies.
scripts.integration_notes: Enforces repository script lifecycle contracts (Issue #214), preventing unmaintained automation drift.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only scan of product.json manifests against git tracked tree; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on clean distribution rights; exit 1 on rights contradictions; exit 2 on incomplete authorities.
scripts.integration_notes: Enforces that proprietary or non-redistributable content cannot be bundled into public distributions.

scripts.system_boundary: Network egress via HTTPS to PyPI Stats API; appends data rows to tools/data/pypi-downloads.csv.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on successful data poll; exit 1 on API error, rate limit, or invalid response.
scripts.integration_notes: Telemetry feeder connecting public package download velocity to commercial product offering prioritization (Issue #215).

scripts.system_boundary: Local JSON parsing and cryptographic signature checking on landing receipts; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on valid comprehension receipt; exit 1 on schema failure, tamper detection, or missing signature.
scripts.integration_notes: Provides mathematical provenance verifying human operator and user sign-off on product landing interfaces.

scripts.system_boundary: Node.js schema validation of product.json against product-admission-v1.schema.json; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on valid manifest schema; exit 1 on schema validation error.
scripts.integration_notes: Automated admission gate verifying tier, distribution, lifecycle, and tool matrix for all OSS products.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only static parse of YAML workflow files under .github/workflows/; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on compliant workflows; exit 1 on unpinned 3rd-party actions or YAML 1.1 unquoted boolean keys.
scripts.integration_notes: Enforces supply-chain immutability and StepSecurity pinning across all fleet CI pipelines.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only parse of PRIMITIVES.md and test directory in hummbl-governance; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on verified count claims; exit 1 on claim drift or unverified counts.
scripts.integration_notes: Direct technical implementation of Claim Honesty Protocol, preventing documentation inflation.

scripts.system_boundary: Unpacks and repacks sdist archives to enforce deterministic timestamps and UID/GID permissions; local disk writes.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on clean sdist normalization; exit 1 on archive corruption or missing files.
scripts.integration_notes: Guarantees byte-for-byte reproducible package distributions on PyPI for hummbl-bus.

scripts.system_boundary: Parses mental model routing results and extracts deterministic baseline fixtures; local disk writes.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on valid extraction; exit 1 on malformed evaluation logs.
scripts.integration_notes: Supplies golden baseline data for cross-fleet model evaluation and mental model selection.

scripts.system_boundary: Read-only reflection comparing Python dataclass fields with JSON schema definitions; zero network egress.
scripts.failure_behavior: Exit 0 on consistent fields; exit 1 on mismatched types, missing fields, or naming drift.
scripts.integration_notes: Prevents semantic divergence between Typed Tuples protocols and runtime implementation code.
